inputs.text: That “8 million” figure is just the organizers’ claim, and authorities still haven’t provided a count. That silence is convenient: it leaves the headline free to turn scattered events into a supposedly unified national wave against Trump. The organizers’ claims of about one million more people and 600 more events than in October are part of the same sales pitch, not independent verification. This looks like coordinated narrative-building—using scale and repetition to manufacture momentum and make opposition seem more decisive than the evidence shows.
